q: In Zephaniah, how does the LORD rejoice over His people?
why: He quiets them with His love.
quote: He will rejoice over you with singing.

q: In Zephaniah, where is the LORD your God?
quote: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save.

q: In Zephaniah, what great day is near and coming quickly?
quote: The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly.

q: In Zephaniah, with what will the LORD quiet His people?
quote: He will quiet you with His love

q: In whose days as king did Zephaniah prophesy?
quote: in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah

q: Who was the prophet Zephaniah's father?
why: Zephaniah was a descendant of Hezekiah.
quote: the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi
